Name: Unlimited Watering Can Water
Author: Bork8008
Description:
This mod removes the water limit from the watering can, allowing you to water crops without ever needing to refill it.
When the watering can is equipped, its water level is automatically kept full. This also keeps the in-game water meter visually full, so there’s no confusing empty bar while the mod is active.
The mod is intentionally simple and lightweight. It does not add menus, config files, or extra features — it just removes the need to refill the watering can so you can focus on farming.
This is a SMAPI-only mod and does [b]not[/b] use Harmony patches.
Features[list]
[*]Unlimited water in the watering can
[*]Water meter always shows full
[*]No configuration required
[*]Lightweight and unobtrusive
[*]Compatible with all watering can upgrades
[/list]Notes[list]
[*]The mod only affects the watering can
[*]Works automatically when the tool is selected
[*]Designed to be simple and reliable
[/list]
